query:
SELECT a.user_id, a.credential_ciphertext FROM imap_accounts a JOIN email_links l ON l.id=a.link_id
             WHERE a.link_id=$1 AND a.sync_generation=$2 AND a.grant_generation=$3
               AND l.macro_id=a.user_id AND l.provider='IMAP' AND l.is_sync_active
               AND l.disconnect_requested_at IS NULL AND l.deleting_at IS NULL
               AND l.sync_generation=a.sync_generation AND l.grant_generation=a.grant_generation
